title: FLAT HUD BARS
why: The critic on the raid screen (10-19): the vitals bars are glossy gradients. The style guide asks for flat bars.
now: The health, armour and stamina bars are flat colour with no gloss.

edits.anchor: try{ gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,y,0,y+h); gr.addColorStop(0,litHex(c,0.22,true)); gr.addColorStop(0.5,c); gr.addColorStop(1,darkHex(c,0.80)); ctx.fillStyle=gr; }catch(_g){ ctx.fillStyle=c; }
edits.replacement: ctx.fillStyle=c;   // v28.xx (cw-flatbars): flat fill, no gradient (the critic, 10-19: bars are still glossy gradients; the style guide wants flat bars)
// v28.xx (cw-flatbars): the light line along the top of the fill is gone with the gloss
